propositions: The env-var registry generator recognizes only os.environ.get, os.environ[...] subscript, and os.getenv forms, silently dropping any other accessor pattern (pop, setdefault, __getitem__) from docs/env-vars.md without error.
Changing os.environ.get to os.environ.pop for a read still accesses the variable but removes it from the generated registry, causing silent documentation loss with no build signal.
The CI drift gate only runs in the full test suite, not in make lint, so stale registries pass local checks and feedback on documentation loss is delayed to CI or absent entirely.
The generator must classify every os.environ attribute access and raise UnrecognisedEnvironAccess for unexpected patterns, making silent omissions impossible and fail-closing the recognizer.
The local lint gate must run the generator's --check to achieve parity with CI and catch staleness before commit.
At least two live os.environ.pop sites in the codebase are currently invisible to the generator, creating latent risk for future refactors.
